title: Planet Parade A-Z
hook: One universe holds scales too large for one parade line.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: colorful 3D preschool planets-and-stars storybook, rounded planets, soft nebula accents, high-contrast foreground objects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child zooming outward through astronomical scale
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written scale hierarchy; hardware does not masquerade as astronomy
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: scale cue -> recall beat -> target -> zoom/point gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a two-note celesta orbit figure with brushed shaker answering only after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a two-note celesta orbit figure with brushed shaker answering only after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn Planet Parade into a scale-and-category gallery: astronaut and hardware in the foreground, moons and planets in the Solar System, Kuiper Belt farther out, then galaxy and universe at vastly larger scales.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child zooms outward: human scale -> spacecraft -> moon/planet -> outer system -> galaxy -> universe, then zooms back to instruments.
semanticArc: galaxy/universe scale then return to tools
